verdict.rationale: The only support is community commentary: one comment calls K3 a "Chinese open-weight model" and another praises it as "open source". No first-party docs name a license, point to a source repository, or show that the CLI, desktop, or editor tools are open source, and open weights are not the same as readable product source. Missing for 10: first-party statement of an open license, a public source repository for the product/CLI, clarity on whether the license covers source or only model weights, and independent verification.
